nameOrigin: dark area created by blocking out light
referring to ‘shadow puppet’, casting shadow shapes with one’s hands

pokedexEntries.ru: SHUPPET is attracted by feelings of jealousy and vindictiveness. If someone develops strong feelings of vengeance, this POKéMON will appear in a swarm and line up beneath the eaves of that person’s home.

pokedexEntries.sa: SHUPPET grows by feeding on dark emotions, such as vengefulness and envy, in the hearts of people. It roams through cities in search of grudges that taint people.

pokedexEntries.frlg: It loves to feed on feelings like envy and malice. Its upright horn catches the emotions of people.

pokedexEntries.em: This POKéMON roams about deep in the night seeking such negative emotions as grudges and envy. It retreats to its nest when the sun begins to rise.

pokedexEntries.dpp: It loves vengeful emotions and hangs in rows under the eaves of houses where vengeful people live.

pokedexEntries.hgss: It uses its horn to feed on envy and malice, or so it’s said. It’s very active at night.

pokedexEntries.bw: It loves vengeful emotions and hangs in rows under the eaves of houses where vengeful people live.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: It feeds on the dark emotions of sadness and hatred, which make it grow steadily stronger.
